thread.text: This is the third time I’m contacting support about the data export tool failing. I was told in my last two tickets that this was being handled, but I’m still seeing the same 'export failed' message every single time I try to pull our logs.

I can see the history of your previous requests regarding the Enterprise data export. Could you tell me if you are attempting to export the full historical range or a specific date bracket when the failure occurs?

It doesn't matter what range I pick; it fails regardless, and quite honestly, if we can't get our own data out of your system, we are going to have to look at moving our entire contract to a competitor who actually delivers on their promises.
